name: boundary-argv-exact-pin
body: Three limits. (1) The boundary e2e case pins the exact stub argv for the forced scan (["scan", <repo>, "--force"]). Limit: any future scan flag inserted ahead of --force in apg_scan's spawnArgs breaks the equality assertion even though the behaviour is correct. Upgrade by relaxing the assertion to a containment check when another flag is added before --force. (2) The session scenario's comments state that a routed mutation lands in the worktree database at admission, but the scenario proves only that no node file appears before save — it never routes a read through the session before the save to see the row. Upgrade by adding that pre-save routed-read assertion when the scenario is next touched. (3) The faked transform callback annotates its parameter as `typeof editor`, which binds the outer `const editor` by name rather than structurally. Limit: renaming that outer const without moving the annotation re-introduces a type error at boundary.e2e.test.ts:999. Upgrade by giving the callback an explicit structural type (or renaming both together) when the fixture is next touched.
